title: How to invest in water as droughts, shortages dominate the news
description: Water has become a popular topic these days, given widespread drought conditions around the globe and the water crisis in Jackson, Miss. That doesn’t translate into an automatic win-win when it comes to investing in the sector.

title: What is COP27? Key issues for markets to watch as U.N. climate talks kick off in Egypt
description: The United Nations' Conference of the Parties, or COP27, takes place as the globe struggles with food and energy shortages, inflation and a war in Ukraine.

title: Pentair Beats Q3 Estimates, Raises Profit Outlook As CEO Credits 'Strong Execution'
description: Pentair reported strong Q3 results, beating estimates and raising its full-year profit outlook. The company's CEO credited 'strong execution' and a balanced approach across its water portfolio for the performance.
